scientific_integrity: The proof is an exact elementary supporting-functional argument. Finite independent LP and convex-hull calculations support but do not replace universal proof. Novelty assessment has residual bibliographic risk, and independent scientific audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight shortest-path complete multipartite metrics with at least three nonempty parts; does not treat bipartite stars, general weighted metrics, higher face posets or the entire odd Laplacian spectrum. Some low-dimensional and bipartite special cases are already known.
title: Two-sheeted skeletons and hidden regularity of complete multipartite transportation balls
